capabilities: Set link weight multipliers for forward and backward links
Choose whether forward weight counts all descendants or only immediate children
Convert character counts into node weight
Manually assign weight overrides to specific files
extras: The README has an empty Demo section; author notes the plugin is new and may have bugs, and directs bug reports to the repo's Issues section.
intentEvidence: This plugin helps you customize the factors that effect node size in obsidian graph view.
problem: Obsidian's graph view uses a fixed sizing scheme, so users cannot control how letter counts or link weights affect how large nodes appear.
summary: Graph view plugin that lets you customize which factors (letter count, forward/backward link weights, manual values) determine node size.
